rules_preserved: Canonical relationship data remains the source of truth for PQ-to-skill identity/association.
Research fields such as ultimate_finish_required, trigger_scope, guarantee_status, and drop_rate are evidence metadata and cannot override canonical identities/edges.
Historical/research-batch evidence is preserved even when unresolved or conflicting.
No canonical relationship edge or skill identity is inferred from presentation-only data.
current_baseline_note: The authoritative repository-wide relationship baseline is 853 unique edges; the skill domain remains 244 edges and is unchanged. The canonical skill registry is now 470 records after the Hyper/Ice endpoint recovery; the additional five skills do not change the PQ relationship graph.
